name: Naga at the Zoram Strand
summary: At Zoram Strand, Naga threaten the Horde's hold on Ashenvale's coast. From Zoram'gar Outpost, Marukai seeks to drive the Wrathtail away from the sunken ruins of ancient Zoram.

sections.title: A Precarious Foothold
sections.body: The Horde's hold on Zoram Strand is fragile. Hostile night elf territory and bitter woodland fighting surround the outpost, whose coast links the Horde to the sea. Aggressive naga have now crawled ashore. They could cut off that link and overwhelm the small garrison before its defenses are ready.

sections.title: Echoes of Doomed Zoram
sections.body: Zoram Strand's sandy shoals hide the shattered remains of Zoram, an ancient elven city swallowed by the Great Sundering thousands of years ago. Marukai and the outpost's defenders do not know why the Wrathtail have come out of the deep trenches now. Their sudden interest in the sunken ruins threatens anyone walking above them.

sections.title: The Price of Survival
sections.body: Marukai sees a simple fight for survival. With swords and tridents drawn, reason matters little. She demands twenty severed heads from the Wrathtail, hoping force will drive the naga back into the depths and secure the shore for the Horde.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Naga at the Zoram Strand?
faq.answer: Marukai, a Darkspear troll, gives the task from the Horde outpost of Zoram'gar on Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is the history behind the Zoram Strand?
faq.answer: Zoram Strand lies along the resting place of the ancient city of Zoram. The Sundering destroyed and submerged it beneath the Great Sea long ago, and its ruins now lie partly underwater along the Ashenvale coast.

faq.q: Why are the naga attacking the shore?
faq.answer: The Horde garrison does not know why the Wrathtail have arrived. The naga have surged from the deep ocean to claim the sunken ruins and drive off land-dwellers.

faq.q: Which enemies do I need to fight for this quest?
faq.answer: You face members of the Wrathtail tribe, who crawl across Zoram Strand's beaches and surf. Marukai asks you to bring her twenty of their severed heads.

faq.q: What quest follows Naga at the Zoram Strand?
faq.answer: Marukai offers no further task after this one. She thanks you and asks for more of your kind to help hold Zoram Strand.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this remote beach?
faq.answer: Ashenvale is fiercely contested by the Horde and the Night Elves. A secure beachhead at Zoram Strand gives the Horde sea access and supply lines beyond the dense inland forests.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help hold Zoram'gar Outpost and secure a foothold in Ashenvale. Driving off the naga is a matter of military survival.
As an orc, you know the value of Marukai's direct, forceful approach to defending a frontier.
